hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy local choices fail because a temporary lexicographical increase may unlock a globally smaller string.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Breadth-first search visits all reachable unique states (at most 10 * 10 * n) in reasonable time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that state space is small and formulate clean graph traversal.
